release_name: Promote beta: Near me location message
notes: Promotes mauritius-mass-finder-beta v27.6.2. Fixes two problems reported on iPhone when location is refused for Near me. (1) The message was a toast that vanished after 1.8 seconds and, being a pill with no maximum width, wrapped into a black blob over the results. (2) Pressing Near me again only reproduced it with no way to recover. Root cause of the second is a browser rule, not a bug we can remove: once the user taps Do not Allow, the browser remembers the refusal and every later request fails instantly without showing a prompt, so no script can ask again - closing and reopening the app does not reset it. The app made this worse by switching Near me off and returning Home on failure, which destroyed the persistent panel it already had for exactly this case. It now stays in Near me and shows that panel, with wording matched to the real cause: a refusal explains how to re-enable location in device Settings, a timeout says to check signal and retry. The failure reason was previously discarded, so all three causes produced the same sentence. Try again works as soon as the user re-enables it, and Show all Masses instead prevents a dead end. Toast now has a maximum width, a softer radius and a duration that scales with message length. No data change: 417 rows, 120 sites.
